title: Best Podcast Marketing Experts (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a podcast marketing expert to grow your listeners: what to include, how to brief it, what drives the price and the red flags.
intro: Podcast marketing helps new listeners find your show and keeps existing ones coming back. It covers show listings, guest appearances on other podcasts, clips for social media, newsletters and ads. It goes wrong when services sell fake downloads, when effort goes into platforms your audience does not use, or when nobody measures what actually grows the show. This guide helps you hire for real listeners.

faq.a: Improving show titles and descriptions, booking guest spots on other shows, creating clips and audiograms, social media, newsletters, cross-promotions and ads.

faq.q: Can I buy downloads or reviews?
faq.a: Fake downloads and reviews mislead sponsors and can break platform rules. Real growth comes from reaching listeners who actually play episodes.
Often guest appearances on related shows and cross-promotions, because they reach people who already listen to podcasts. Clips on social media also help new people sample your show.
Downloads per episode, listeners who follow or subscribe, and how many listen to most of an episode. Your hosting platform and podcast apps provide these.

faq.q: Do I need a website for my podcast?
faq.a: It helps with search and gives listeners one place for episodes, notes and links.
